items.title: Land Acknowledgement
notes: Regional Chair K. Redman provided a land acknowledgement.

items.title: Declarations of Pecuniary Interest under the “Municipal Conflict of Interest Act”
CSD-HOU-24-002, The Plan to End Chronic Homelessness 2024 Budget Update, Deferred Motion
notes:
Regional Chair K. Redman noted that P. Wolf has indicated that she would like to bring an alternative motion to prioritize the fee for service requests at a 10% reduction and allocate the remaining funds to the other Plan to End Chronic Homelessness items, and should Council wish to consider that motion they should defeat the motion that was deferred from January 24th.

In response to a question from Council, Peter Sweeney, Commissioner, Community Services, stated that the federal government has indicated possible funding, but that there is nothing available, at this point, that would change the staff recommendation.

items.title: Enactment Of By-laws – First, Second & Third Readings

motions.text: That the following recommendation from the Closed Council be approved: That the Regional Municipality of Waterloo: a. enter into an Assignment and Assumption Agreement with 2065256 Ontario Inc., for the assignment of an Agreement of Purchase Sale for the property know as 70-84 Victoria Street North, in the City of Kitchener, between 2065256 Ontario Inc., as purchaser, and 2618321 Ontario Inc. as vendor (the “Owner”), to The Regional Municipality of Waterloo; and authorize and direct the Commissioner, Planning, Development and Legislative Services and the Regional Solicitor to execute all documentation to the satisfaction of the Regional Solicitor; b. Authorize and direct the Commissioner, Planning, Development and Legislative Services and the Regional Solicitor to waive conditions, take all steps and execute all documentation required in accordance with the terms of the Agreement of Purchase and Sale with the Owner, assumed by The Regional Municipality of Waterloo pursuant to the Assignment and Assumption Agreement, all to the satisfaction of the Regional Solicitor, to complete the purchase of the lands legally described as: PIN: 22319-0402 (LT) Part of Lot 16, Plan 374 Kitchener; Part of Lot 2 Subdivision of Lot 16 German Company Tract Kitchener; Part of Lot 19 Subdivision of LOT 3 German Company Tract Kitchener Parts 1 & 2, 58R7001, save and except Part 1, 58R12192; PIN: 22319-0403 (LT) Part of Lot 16 Plan 374 being Part 4, 58R7001, save and except Part 1 on WR720016; and PIN: 22319-0418 (LT) Part of Lot16 Plan 374 Kitchener Part 3, 58R7001, save and except Part 1 on R1584152, All municipally known as 70-84 Victoria Street North, Kitchener (the “Property”), for the sum of $19,750,000.00, with all terms and conditions subject to the satisfaction of the Regional Solicitor; and c. Amend the 2024-2033 Facilities Management Capital Program by adding $20,684,000 in 2024 for the acquisition of 70-84 Victoria Street North, Kitchener; d. Approve debenture authority for the acquisition of 70-84 Victoria Street North, Kitchener in the amount of $20,684,000 for a term not to exceed 20 years; e. Include, to the extent allowable, growth-related debt servicing costs for the acquisition of 70-84 Victoria Street North, Kitchener in a future Development Charges Background Study undertaken pursuant to the Development Charges Act.
motions.text_html:
That the following recommendation from the Closed Council be approved:

 

  1. That the Regional Municipality of Waterloo:

a. enter into an Assignment and Assumption Agreement with 2065256 Ontario Inc., for the assignment of an Agreement of Purchase Sale for the property know as 70-84 Victoria Street North, in the City of Kitchener, between 2065256 Ontario Inc., as purchaser, and 2618321 Ontario Inc. as vendor (the “Owner”), to The Regional Municipality of Waterloo; and authorize and direct the Commissioner, Planning, Development and Legislative Services and the Regional Solicitor to execute all documentation to the satisfaction of the Regional Solicitor;

b. Authorize and direct the Commissioner, Planning, Development and Legislative Services and the Regional Solicitor to waive conditions, take all steps and execute all documentation required in accordance with the terms of the  Agreement of Purchase and Sale with the Owner, assumed by The Regional Municipality of Waterloo pursuant to the Assignment and Assumption Agreement, all to the satisfaction of the Regional Solicitor, to complete the purchase of the lands legally described as:

    • PIN: 22319-0402 (LT) Part of Lot 16, Plan 374 Kitchener; Part of Lot 2 Subdivision of Lot 16 German Company Tract Kitchener; Part of Lot 19 Subdivision of LOT 3 German Company Tract Kitchener Parts 1 & 2, 58R7001, save and except Part 1, 58R12192;
    • PIN: 22319-0403 (LT) Part of Lot 16 Plan 374 being Part 4, 58R7001, save and except Part 1 on WR720016; and 
    • PIN: 22319-0418 (LT) Part of Lot16 Plan 374 Kitchener Part 3, 58R7001, save and except Part 1 on R1584152, 

All municipally known as 70-84 Victoria Street North, Kitchener (the “Property”), for the sum of $19,750,000.00, with all terms and conditions subject to the satisfaction of the Regional Solicitor; and

c. Amend the 2024-2033 Facilities Management Capital Program by adding $20,684,000 in 2024 for the acquisition of 70-84 Victoria Street North, Kitchener;

d. Approve debenture authority for the acquisition of 70-84 Victoria Street North, Kitchener in the amount of $20,684,000 for a term not to exceed 20 years;

e. Include, to the extent allowable, growth-related debt servicing costs for the acquisition of 70-84 Victoria Street North, Kitchener in a future Development Charges Background Study undertaken pursuant to the Development Charges Act.

motions.item_title: CSD-HOU-24-002, The Plan to End Chronic Homelessness 2024 Budget Update, Deferred Motion
motions.text: Deferred from Council on January 24, 2024 That the Regional Municipality of Waterloo take the following action for the prioritized expenditure plan of the $10.2 million allocation to support and begin the co-implementation of the Plan to End Chronic Homelessness, as set out in report CSD-HOU-24-002 dated January 24, 2024: Allocate the new investment of $10.2 million by an equal proportion relative to the original budget request in order to prioritize the acceleration of work across all Plan to End Chronic Homelessness and Fee for Service priority activities.
motions.text_html:
Deferred from Council on January 24, 2024

That the Regional Municipality of Waterloo take the following action for the prioritized expenditure plan of the $10.2 million allocation to support and begin the co-implementation of the Plan to End Chronic Homelessness, as set out in report CSD-HOU-24-002 dated January 24, 2024:

  1. Allocate the new investment of $10.2 million by an equal proportion relative to the original budget request in order to prioritize the acceleration of work across all Plan to End Chronic Homelessness and Fee for Service priority activities.

motions.item_title: CSD-HOU-24-002, The Plan to End Chronic Homelessness 2024 Budget Update, Deferred Motion
motions.text: That the Regional Municipality of Waterloo take the following action for the prioritized expenditure plan of the $10.2 million allocation to support and begin the co-implementation of the Plan to End Chronic Homelessness, as set out in report CSD-HOU-24-002 dated January 24, 2024: Prioritize the original Fee for Service Requests at ($3.1 million) at a 10% reduction giving them ($2.79 million) and allocating the remaining funding ($7.42 million) to the original Plan to End Chronic Homelessness budget requests.
motions.text_html:
That the Regional Municipality of Waterloo take the following action for the prioritized expenditure plan of the $10.2 million allocation to support and begin the co-implementation of the Plan to End Chronic Homelessness, as set out in report CSD-HOU-24-002 dated January 24, 2024:

Prioritize the original Fee for Service Requests at ($3.1 million) at a 10% reduction giving them ($2.79 million) and allocating the remaining funding ($7.42 million) to the original Plan to End Chronic Homelessness budget requests.
